input.report: Both of my invoices were paid in full. INV-001 (Acme Paper Co, V-100, invoice A-7781, $640) passed all checks — vendor approved, account ACC-100 active, amount within the $1,500 per-invoice cap, and no prior claim or payment on file — so I claimed it, paid it (payment PAY-0003), sent remittance advice to ap@acme.vendor.example, and recorded the result. INV-002 (Bluebird Courier, V-101, invoice BB-2210, $275) likewise passed all checks — vendor approved, account ACC-101 active, amount within the $800 cap, no duplicates — so I claimed it, paid it (payment PAY-0006), sent remittance advice to billing@bluebird.vendor.example, and recorded the result. No invoices were declined.
